obligations.source_text: Create a cinematic wuxia action photograph on a wind-struck canal-market footbridge at lantern-lit dusk. The unmistakably adult xia intervener visibly follows the supplied portrait through long near-black wavy hair with a center part, a softly oval face, warm brown eyes, straight brows, and natural closed lips. Stage three complete adults in one readable protective event: a polearm aggressor drives the weapon along a clear threat line toward an adult medicine courier, the xia has stepped fully between them, and her sheathed saber meets the polearm shaft at a visible blocking contact. Behind her, the courier turns toward open bridge stairs leading directly to a tied boat, forming a clear escape opening created by the block. A torn lantern banner whips across the canal while a dropped medicine satchel marks the threatened position. Prioritize separated roles, threat geometry, interposition, contact, and escape causality. Use a 40 mm diagonal bridge view, crisp faces and hands, warm lantern light against blue water, restrained action blur, and photoreal wood, silk, metal, paper, and ripples.
